basis: Independent transcription from SI synthesis of 119-23, printed p. 7, and Supplementary Fig. 4 top structure, printed p. 15; not generated by a reaction transform.

conditions.locator: SI printed pp. 7-8, PDF pp. 8-9, Synthesis of 119-23
conditions.preincubation: Aldehyde and amine in 1 mL dichloromethane, room temperature, 1 h in a 4-dram glass vial
conditions.addition: Oleic acid and 1-adamantyl isocyanide, then 1 mL methanol
conditions.reaction: Room temperature overnight; catalyst and atmosphere not specified for final assembly
conditions.workup: TLC monitoring followed by silica gel chromatography, 10% methanol in dichloromethane with 0.1% ammonium hydroxide
conditions.characterization: Product-specific QTOF mass spectrum and 1H/13C NMR provided; spectra not independently reinterpreted

visual_inspection.main: Complete four-reactant scheme and net water loss in Figure 1 viewed
visual_inspection.stereochemistry: Reported oleate unsaturation and adamantane connectivity retained; E/Z and stereochemical labels removed only for the declared constitutional model

limitations: The supplement contains labeling inconsistencies in earlier tail-synthesis sections, including compound 10 under the 3-prime alcohol procedure; these are not inherited as exact L2 evidence.
The 119-23 control supports aldehyde Ugi 4CR only. It does not qualify ketone Ugi 4CR, source-bank membership of v8 products, biological labels, component synthesis, or procurement.
